components.text: As established, Demonic Will coalesces around certain creatures and propels them with malevolent force. This isn't the only place Will can exist, though - it's possible to release Will into a chunk's ambient Aura, where various Rituals can then draw on it for bonus effects.

The Aura is chunk-based: Will you release fills up the chunk it's released in, up to a total cap for each of the five aspects (Raw, Corrosive, Steadfast, Destructive, Vengeful). You can measure this using a Demon Will Aura Gauge.
Note: on this branch, the specific old machines for feeding the Aura (Demon Crucible, Demon Pylon) are not present as separate blocks - the underlying chunk-based Aura that Rituals read from is real and functional, but exactly how Will currently gets released into it may differ from earlier versions. Check current recipes/mechanics in-game.
